🌎 BEYOND THE 956

A 97-year-old California man died at his own birthday party moments after dancing to the Bee Gees' “Stayin' Alive” — a send-off his friends say the fun-loving senior would have wanted.

Vito, whose last name has not been publicly reported, was celebrating his 97th birthday at a Halloween-themed party thrown by his neighbor, Los Angeles baker Eden Malinoff, 24. Malinoff, who runs the cake and cookie business Baked, baked him a red wine chocolate cake for the occasion.

In footage Malinoff posted to TikTok on Monday, Vito was seen clapping, swaying and smiling, dressed in a black button-down shirt and dress pants, as the 1977 disco classic played. The celebration took a sudden turn shortly after guests sang “Happy Birthday” to him, and Vito died at the party, surrounded by his friends.

His best friend, Caleb Turner, confirmed Vito's death on social media, saying he had medical issues those around him had not realized were so serious, and that he “passed away peacefully with his favorite music going.” No official cause of death has been reported. Malinoff said the timing was “just a freak coincidence,” and friends said they believe “he was ready and honestly there's not a better way to go.”

Malinoff's tribute video has since attracted more than 9.5 million views on TikTok.

Rest in Peace, Vito.

Sources: New York Post; Dexerto; LADbible.

title: Beyond the 956: 97-year-old Vito dies at his own birthday party moments after dancing to “Stayin' Alive”
